newsitem.title: POLAND: Novita ups '97 net view to PLN 6.1 mln.
newsitem.headline: Novita ups '97 net view to PLN 6.1 mln.

text.p: Polish carpet maker Novita SA has increased its net profit forecast to 6.1 million zlotys from the 5.4 million zlotys it predicted last October, the company said in a statement on Friday.
Novita said the projected 52 percent earnings growth from 1996 would be accompanied by sales growth of 35.8 percent to 91.5 million zlotys.
It said the forecast assumed that no dividend would be paid for 1996 and that the firm would not raise new capital in 1997.
Last year Novita earned four million zlotys on sales of 67.6 million zlotys. -- Warsaw Newsroom +48 22 653 9700
